register: Printed-denominator record, all organization classes: the printed 1,724 counts every published numeric headline rating (overall for MA-PD, Part C summary for MA-only, Part D summary for PDP; cost contracts included, since CMS issues them ratings) at the baseline vintages; n_rated = the replay aggregation produces the headline (raw condition), all classes. The numerator counts flips in the dollar estimate (QBP-relevant) while the 1,724 denominator counts all issued ratings, which is what the phrase 'of the 1,724 ratings CMS issued' states.
